title.narrative: Sustainability Linked Loan Framework for the Ministry of Finance of Mexico

description.narrative: Design and formulate the Sustainability-Linked Loan Framework for the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit of Mexico to access a credit facility promoted by the Development Bank of Latin America and the Caribbean (CAF). The financial conditions of this loan will be tied to the achievement of specific Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Sustainability Performance Targets (SPTs) related to national greenhouse gas emission reduction targets and addressing gender disparities. This framework will undergo verification by an external entity to ensure alignment with international best practices.
Implementation of a new thematic financing instrument aimed at a mobilization of 300 million USD with an interest rate subjet to achieving green and social targets
